title: 公路车外胎对比之马牌gsr对比正新1922
notes: Owner comparison (edited 2025-11-30): CST C1922 about 40 g lighter than the Continental GSR, true 25C width, thinner and softer, more comfortable but noisier; small cuts appeared in the soft tread within 200 km. A commenter used one daily for two years with several tread cuts.
